corpus_dataset_metadata.name: Smoke set — five sessions
corpus_dataset_metadata.description: Five sessions and six questions across all three difficulty bands. Too small to measure anything and not meant to: it is the set you run end to end in seconds to check that a pipeline works before spending an hour on one that does not. Deliberately declares no date-typed label and no ranks label, so this is the corpus that exercises the "no time behaviour" path on every run.
